# 行舟 · 个人行动与生活系统 v0.7.0

这一版本把“事务”从一段僵硬的起止日期，升级为可以自由安排、逐次完成的执行切片，并让“项目与事务”和“生活节律”真正共享当天的个人安排。

## 主要更新

- 事务可设置目标切片数和每片预计时长，再通过详情页日历安排每次执行日期；切片不会成为子事务，也不改变原有层级。
- 切片支持已安排、已完成、未完成和已放弃。进度以百分比显示；未完成或放弃保留历史，并自动释放一个新的待安排名额。
- “本周”直接显示执行切片；配置切片的事务不再从开始日到截止日每天重复出现。
- 没有截止日期也能从今天起自由安排切片；存在截止日期时，它只作为最晚可安排日期。
- “生活节律”会自动显示当天的个人事务切片，也可从进行中的事务补充当天切片并同步回项目视图。
- 每日记录启用自动保存，并重构为早晨、午饭后、下班、下班后、21:00 五段时间动线；训练和工作闭环均按状态按需展开。
- 切换模块后恢复原来的项目页面、筛选、层级展开、选中项和滚动位置。
- 修复切片日历不可点击或跳动、首次选择结果不生效、个人事务排序不同步及多处表单对齐问题。

## 升级说明

本版本兼容现有 `work-items.json` 和 `daily-records.json`。旧工作项不需要迁移；只有主动配置目标切片数的事务才会使用新的切片排期方式，原有计划日期和逐日完成记录继续保留。

# Xingzhou · Personal Action & Life System v0.7.0

This release replaces rigid date-range repetition with independently schedulable execution slices and connects today's personal work directly across Projects & Tasks and Life Rhythm.

## Highlights

- Transactions can define a target slice count and per-slice estimate, then schedule each execution date from the detail calendar. Slices never become child work items or alter the hierarchy.
- Slices support Scheduled, Completed, Missed, and Abandoned states. Progress is shown as a percentage; missed and abandoned attempts remain in history and release a replacement slot.
- Week displays explicit execution slices, so slice-enabled transactions are no longer repeated on every date from start through deadline.
- Transactions without a deadline can schedule freely from today onward. When present, a deadline acts only as the latest schedulable date.
- Life Rhythm automatically shows today's personal slices and can add a same-day slice from an in-progress transaction with immediate synchronization back to the project view.
- Daily records now save automatically and follow a Morning, After lunch, Clock-out, After work, and 21:00 flow. Training and work-closure details expand only when applicable.
- Returning between modules restores the previous project page, filters, hierarchy expansion, selection, and scroll position.
- Fixed disabled or shifting slice calendars, first-selection display errors, inconsistent personal-task ordering, and several form-alignment issues.

## Upgrade notes

This release is compatible with existing `work-items.json` and `daily-records.json`. No migration is required. Only Transactions given a target slice count use the new slice schedule; legacy planned dates and per-day completion records remain available.
